caption: Figure 2. Residual learning: a building block.
description:
Figure type: Diagram
Description: The figure shows a diagram of a residual learning block, which is a fundamental building block in deep residual learning. It consists of two weight layers, each followed by a ReLU activation function. The input x is passed through the first weight layer and then through a ReLU function. The output of the first weight layer is added to the input x, and the result is passed through another ReLU function. The final output is the sum of the output of the second weight layer and the input x.
